dataset_metadata.name: DerKurator AI demo portfolio
dataset_metadata.note: All projects, demands, people, teams and figures are invented for demos and automated tests; they describe no real organisation.

Projects.project_summary: Move the remaining on-premise hosting into two certified hybrid zones before the data-centre lease expires.
Projects.business_case: Move the remaining on-premise hosting into two certified hybrid zones before the data-centre lease expires.
Projects.target_situation: One hosting standard with automated patching, capacity reporting and tested failover.
Projects.value_added: Lower hosting cost, fewer outages and a reusable landing zone for new services.
Projects.risk_of_performing: Cutover work may interrupt connected processes and ties up scarce specialists.
Projects.risk_of_not_performing: Penalties under the existing lease contract and a rising risk of outages.
Projects.assumptions: Application owners confirm migration windows four weeks in advance.

Projects.project_summary: Merge three subsidiary ledgers into one group ledger with a common posting logic.
Projects.business_case: Merge three subsidiary ledgers into one group ledger with a common posting logic.
Projects.target_situation: A shared month-end close calendar and fewer manual journal entries.
Projects.value_added: Shorter close, clearer reporting lines and less reconciliation work.
Projects.risk_of_performing: Cutover work may interrupt connected processes and ties up scarce specialists.
Projects.risk_of_not_performing: Manual reconciliations keep growing and month-end stays slow.
Projects.assumptions: Finance leads of each subsidiary join the weekly design board.

Projects.project_summary: Introduce one customer login across web shop, app and service portal with a staged account migration.
Projects.business_case: Introduce one customer login across web shop, app and service portal with a staged account migration.
Projects.target_situation: Fewer password resets, consistent consent handling and reusable login services.
Projects.out_of_scope: Workforce login and privileged administrator accounts.
Projects.value_added: Less login friction and lower fraud losses.
Projects.risk_of_performing: Cutover work may interrupt connected processes and ties up scarce specialists.
Projects.risk_of_not_performing: Security gaps of the old logins stay open and new digital offers remain blocked.
Projects.assumptions: Duplicate customer accounts can be merged before the migration.

Projects.project_summary: Combine carrier status events into one tracking view with automated delay alerts.
Projects.business_case: Combine carrier status events into one tracking view with automated delay alerts.
Projects.target_situation: Reliable delivery dates and fewer manual follow-up calls.
Projects.out_of_scope: Renegotiation of carrier rates and depot automation.
Projects.value_added: Lower express-freight cost and better-informed customers.
Projects.risk_of_performing: Cutover work may interrupt connected processes and ties up scarce specialists.
Projects.risk_of_not_performing: Delays stay invisible until customers complain.
Projects.assumptions: Carriers deliver status events in the agreed format.

Projects.project_summary: Introduce a virtual agent that answers routine support questions and drafts ticket summaries.
Projects.business_case: Introduce a virtual agent that answers routine support questions and drafts ticket summaries.
Projects.target_situation: Shorter handling times with a human sign-off for every consequential action.
Projects.value_added: More first-contact resolutions and more productive support staff.
Projects.risk_of_performing: Cutover work may interrupt connected processes and ties up scarce specialists.
Projects.risk_of_not_performing: Support cost keeps rising and know-how stays scattered.
Projects.assumptions: Knowledge articles are reviewed by their owners every month.

Projects.project_summary: Apply retention periods automatically and record proof of every deletion in the core systems.
Projects.target_situation: Retention driven by policy, with evidence ready for every review.
Projects.value_added: Less manual effort and stronger evidence for reviews.
Projects.risk_of_performing: Cutover work may interrupt connected processes and ties up scarce specialists.
Projects.risk_of_not_performing: Regulatory findings and ever-growing data stocks remain likely.
Projects.assumptions: System owners can name the leading data store for each record type.

Projects.project_summary: Introduce usage-based tariffs, combined invoices and automated payment matching.
Projects.business_case: Introduce usage-based tariffs, combined invoices and automated payment matching.
Projects.target_situation: Scalable tariff products and fewer invoice corrections.
Projects.out_of_scope: Replacement of the core ledger and a redesign of dunning.
Projects.value_added: Room for new tariffs and less revenue leakage.
Projects.risk_of_performing: Cutover work may interrupt connected processes and ties up scarce specialists.
Projects.risk_of_not_performing: New tariffs cannot be launched and invoice disputes increase.
Projects.assumptions: Tariff identifiers stay stable during the migration.

Projects.project_summary: Replace ageing laptops and standardise ordering, imaging, return and disposal.
Projects.business_case: Replace ageing laptops and standardise ordering, imaging, return and disposal.
Projects.target_situation: Shorter provisioning times and an accurate asset register.
Projects.value_added: Fewer support tickets and fewer lost devices.
Projects.risk_of_performing: Cutover work may interrupt connected processes and ties up scarce specialists.
Projects.risk_of_not_performing: Old devices slow staff down and the asset register stays unreliable.
Projects.assumptions: Regional delivery partners keep the agreed lead times.

Projects.project_summary: Build a managed gateway that gives suppliers self-service access to order and invoice interfaces.
Projects.business_case: Build a managed gateway that gives suppliers self-service access to order and invoice interfaces.
Projects.target_situation: Faster supplier onboarding and reuse of existing interfaces.
Projects.out_of_scope: Internal-only interfaces and existing point-to-point links.
Projects.value_added: Shorter onboarding times and new transaction volume.
Projects.risk_of_performing: Cutover work may interrupt connected processes and ties up scarce specialists.
Projects.risk_of_not_performing: Supplier onboarding stays slow and interfaces are built twice.
Projects.assumptions: Standard usage terms can be agreed for the main supplier groups.

Projects.project_summary: Collect energy and emissions data in one platform for reporting and steering.
Projects.business_case: Collect energy and emissions data in one platform for reporting and steering.
Projects.target_situation: Traceable figures and less spreadsheet work in reporting.
Projects.value_added: Reliable reporting and better visibility of supplier emissions.
Projects.risk_of_performing: Cutover work may interrupt connected processes and ties up scarce specialists.
Projects.risk_of_not_performing: Reporting stays manual and figures remain hard to trace.
Projects.assumptions: Purchasing can collect supplier data through standard questionnaires.

Projects.project_summary: Separate production networks from office IT and enforce rule-based traffic controls between zones.
Projects.business_case: Separate production networks from office IT and enforce rule-based traffic controls between zones.
Projects.target_situation: Contained incidents and clear ownership of each network zone.
Projects.out_of_scope: Relocation of the data centre and a change of WAN provider.
Projects.value_added: Lower cyber exposure and fewer unplanned production stops.
Projects.risk_of_performing: Cutover work may interrupt connected processes and ties up scarce specialists.
Projects.risk_of_not_performing: Major security exposure remains and audits demand compensating controls.
Projects.assumptions: Plant engineers validate traffic flows before rules are enforced.
